name: Conductive Ice · Death
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 3.5-block radius for 10 s (water and ground beneath turn to ice). Every second, on everyone inside except you:
• Damage 1.25 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Soaked for 8 s
• Light push
• Cold 40: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Charge 35: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 4 targets in a row, jumps up to 4 blocks, 1.25 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 4 s
• Life drain: 0.5 ❤ damage, you heal 0.2 ❤
self_description:
On you:
• Damage 1.25 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Soaked for 8 s and leaves a puddle
• Light push
• Cold 40: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Charge 35: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 3 s
